import CategoryTheory.SubobjectClassifier
import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.CategoryInstance
import CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.EssentiallySmall.{w, v, u} C] : 
  CategoryTheory.HasSubobjectClassifier (CategoryTheory.Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)) := by
  let F := Functor Cᵒᵖ (Type w)
  have h_locally_small : LocallySmall F :=
    by
    apply LocallySmall.of_essentially_small
    exact (EssentiallySmall.of_essentially_small C).comp (LocallySmall.of_Type w)
  have h_cartesian_closed : CartesianClosed F :=
    by
    apply CartesianClosed.of_functor_category
    exact (EssentiallySmall.of_essentially_small C).comp (LocallySmall.of_Type w)
  have h_subobject_classifier : HasSubobjectClassifier F :=
    by
    apply HasSubobjectClassifier.of_cartesian_closed_locally_small
    exact h_cartesian_closed
    exact h_locally_small
  exact h_subobject_classifier
